name: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarships to the Students belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (PMS-SC)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India (implemented through States/UTs; 60:40 Centre:State)

rules.quote: Only those candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes so specified in relation to the State/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs /domiciled as determined by the State/UT
Scholarships will be paid to the students whose parents’/guardians’ income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/- (Rupees Two lakh Fifty thousand only) during the last Financial Year.

value: post-matric: Class XI-XII, ITI, diploma, UG, PG, MPhil/PhD
rules.quote: Scholarships will be given for the study of all recognized post-matriculation or post- secondary courses (Intermediate/Senior Secondary, Diploma, long-term Vocational Training Certificate, Graduate, Post Graduate courses etc.)

rules.value: Indian nationals; must have passed Matriculation/Higher Secondary or higher
rules.quote: who have passed the Matriculation or Higher Secondary or any higher examination of a recognized University or Board of Secondary Education will be eligible.
These scholarships are available for studies in India only and the awardees are selected by the State Government/Union Territory to which the applicant actually belongs
Only Institutions/Colleges with the 'AISHE Code'/UDISE’ Code’ shall be eligible for the scholarship scheme.

Candidates who, after passing one stage of education are studying in the same stage of education in a different subject e.g. Intermediate Science after Intermediate Arts or B.Com after B.A. or M.A in one subject after M.A in other subjects will not be eligible.

rules.value: correspondence/online students eligible for fees only
rules.quote: Students, who pursue their studies through correspondence/online courses, are also eligible.

rules.value: no limit on number of children per family
rules.quote: All the children of any parent/guardian will be entitled to receive benefits of the scheme.
A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend.

rules.value: management/NRI quota and spot admission seats not eligible
rules.quote: All seats filled through arbitrary and non-transparent processes (including management quota, NRI quota, spot admissions etc.) without following the merit criteria as decided by the State Government are not eligible for these scholarships.

rules.value: renewal needs satisfactory performance and 75% attendance
rules.quote: The award once made will be payable up to the completion of the course subject to satisfactory academic performance and attendance of 75% in every academic year.

amount.text: Compulsory non-refundable fees (incl. tuition as fixed by State Fee Fixation Committee) plus academic allowance by course group (table not legible in OCR; 10% extra for Divyang students; allowance indexed to CPI-IW from April 2022); freeship card for admission without pre-payment
amount.quote: i. Compulsory non-refundable fees including tuition fee, as fixed by the Fee Fixation/Rationalization Committee of the State Government ii. Academic allowance

documents.name: Passport size photograph
documents.quote: the documents may be scanned and uploaded which include: passport size photograph

documents.name: Certificates of all examinations passed
documents.quote: copy of each of the certificates for diploma, degree etc. in respect of all examinations passed

documents.name: Caste certificate
documents.quote: Caste certificate duly signed by the authorized officer

documents.name: Income certificate (once, at admission)
documents.quote: valid Income certificate issued by the competent authority as prescribed by the State Govt.

documents.name: Aadhaar number
documents.quote: register for issuance of a Freeship Card on the respective scholarship portal giving the details like the Aadhaar number

deadline.text: Portal open throughout the year; apply on the State scholarship portal / NSP on the day of admission
deadline.quote: For the purpose of registration of Freeship Card, the portals shall remain open throughout the year.
